mapper.select: SELECT hrpp.*, (SELECT scvb.meaning FROM sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb WHERE scb.code = 'HLS500_PRODUCT_PARA' AND scb.code_id = scvb.code_id AND scvb.value = hrpp.reply_product_para) AS reply_product_para_display FROM hls_reply_product_para hrpp WHERE hrpp.reply_product_id = #{replyProductId} ORDER BY hrpp.reply_product_para ASC

SELECT HRPR.REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA_ID, HRPR.REPLY_PRODUCT_ID, HRPR.REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA, (SELECT B2.MEANING FROM SYS_CODE_B B1, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B B2 WHERE B1.CODE = 'HLS500_PRODUCT_PARA' AND B1.CODE_ID = B2.CODE_ID AND B2.VALUE = HRPR.REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA) REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA_N, HRPR.DEFAULT_VALUE, HRPR.VAULE_FROM, HRPR.VAULE_TO, HRPR.SYSTEM_CONTROL_FLAG FROM HLS_REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA HRPR
HRPR.REPLY_PRODUCT_ID = #{replyProductId}

select pp.*, (select scvb.MEANING from SYS_CODE_B scb, SYS_CODE_VALUE_B scvb where scb.CODE = 'HLS500_PRODUCT_PARA' and scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID and scvb.VALUE = pp.REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA) as REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA_N from HLS_REPLY_PRODUCT_PARA pp
and pp.REPLY_PRODUCT_ID = #{replyProductId}
